subject.title: [Bug]: Control UI cannot queue input while Gateway reconnects

question: Should maintainers promote this maintainer-labeled Control UI reconnect-compose bug to a narrow fix now, or keep it as maintainer-owned backlog?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible and the likely fix boundary is clear, but the protected `maintainer` label prevents this cleanup workflow from auto-closing or queueing repair work without explicit maintainer intent.

options.title: Promote narrow fix
options.body: Fix only the compose/queue gate during reconnect, leave realtime actions connection-bound, and require browser E2E proof for offline submit through reconnect.

options.title: Keep maintainer backlog
options.body: Leave this issue open for manual prioritization if reconnect-compose UX is not urgent for the current release train.

options.title: Expand into state-machine refactor
options.body: Treat this as part of a broader capability-state cleanup, accepting larger scope and slower review.

recommendation.title: Promote narrow fix
recommendation.body: Fix only the compose/queue gate during reconnect, leave realtime actions connection-bound, and require browser E2E proof for offline submit through reconnect.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the mounted reconnect-shell PR and is the strongest recent owner signal for the Control UI reconnect state boundary.
